answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Consistency Rule. Each agent identity is scored on a rolling history of action latencies, decision patterns, and interaction partners; a new identity must replay a publicly timestamped behavioural trace across at least three epochs before gaining governance rights. An anomaly detector compares the candidate trace against a canonical oasis of stable reference agents, flagging divergence. A beacon epoch marker forces every identity to publish signed continuity proofs between epochs, and a ripple check propagates consistency scores to peers who can challenge mismatches.
